summary: The candidate fixes the previously reported unindexed mtp.safetensors omission and passes its focused suite, but remains a partial fix: a recognized requested-layer entry can mask an unknown coexisting draft layout, causing the unknown draft shard to be pruned instead of safely falling back to all prepared shards.

tests.what_was_measured: At recorded base 358c163250ad3b1f62939b01ce1314a0a31a0365, all prepared shards reached the RunAI iterator, reproducing the original missing pre-stream selection behavior.
At prior candidate 8c799873170db6688e35734e591e36a5f188eaa5, reproduced the review counterexample: the auto-added mtp.safetensors was omitted and only draft-1.safetensors reached the iterator.
At exact candidate e9952a5825d098de1c068d061062fe2522981d27, all 16 candidate tests and 6 subtests passed, including the auto-added mtp.safetensors regression.

At exact candidate e9952a5825d098de1c068d061062fe2522981d27, the recognized-only control passed, but the mixed recognized-plus-unknown draft layout case failed because the selector returned only draft-requested.safetensors rather than the complete prepared list.

gpu_execution.evidence: The reviewed change is deterministic Python JSON metadata and path-list selection before the RunAI iterator; it performs no tensor computation.

remaining_counterexamples: If an index contains a recognized requested-layer key such as mtp.1.decoder.weight and also an unknown draft-layout key such as model.nextn.layers.1.shared.weight, while every prepared shard filename appears somewhere in the index, _select_mtp_safetensors selects only the recognized shard and drops the unknown draft shard instead of falling back to the complete prepared list.
remaining_limitations: No native source changed, so a native rebuild was not applicable.
No GPU execution was performed because it would not validate pre-stream JSON/path selection.
No live object-storage credentials or production MTP checkpoint were available; provider I/O reduction, distributed loading, and end-to-end model semantics remain unverified.
